import sys
import math

def multiply_mod(a, b, mod):
    need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    n = max(2, 1 << (need - 1).bit_length())
    a_real = [0.0] * n
    a_imag = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        a_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        a_imag[i] = x >> 15
    fft(a_real, a_imag, False)
    b_real = [0.0] * n
    b_imag = [0.0] * n
    if a is b:
        b_real[:len(a)] = a_real[:len(a)]
        b_imag[:len(a)] = a_imag[:len(a)]
    else:
        for i in range(len(b)):
            x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
            b_real[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            b_imag[i] = x >> 15
        fft(b_real, b_imag, False)
    fa_real = [0.0] * n
    fa_imag = [0.0] * n
    fb_real = [0.0] * n
    fb_imag = [0.0] * n
    cf = 0.25 / n
    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        a1r = a_real[i] + a_real[j]
        a1i = a_imag[i] - a_imag[j]
        a2r = a_imag[i] + a_imag[j]
        a2i = a_real[j] - a_real[i]
        b1r = (b_real[i] + b_real[j]) * cf
        b1i = (b_imag[i] - b_imag[j]) * cf
        b2r = (b_imag[i] + b_imag[j]) * cf
        b2i = (b_real[j] - b_real[i]) * cf
        fa_real[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        fa_imag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        fb_real[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        fb_imag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    fft(fa_real, fa_imag, True)
    fft(fb_real, fb_imag, True)
    res = [0] * need
    for i in range(need):
        aa = round(fa_real[i])
        bb = round(fb_real[i])
        cc = round(fa_imag[i])
        res[i] = int(((aa + (bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)
    return res

def fft(a, b, inverse):
    n = len(a)
    shift = 32 - (n.bit_length() - 1)
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int('{:b}'.format(i << shift)[::-1], 2)
        if i < j:
            a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
            b[i], b[j] = b[j], b[i]
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half = length >> 1
        cos_table = [0.0] * half
        sin_table = [0.0] * half
        for i in range(half):
            angle = 2 * math.pi * i / length * (-1 if inverse else 1)
            cos_table[i] = math.cos(angle)
            sin_table[i] = math.sin(angle)
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            for j in range(half):
                wr = cos_table[j]
                wi = sin_table[j]
                uA = a[i + j]
                uB = b[i + j]
                vA = a[i + j + half] * wr - b[i + j + half] * wi
                vB = a[i + j + half] * wi + b[i + j + half] * wr
                a[i + j] = uA + vA
                b[i + j] = uB + vB
                a[i + j + half] = uA - vA
                b[i + j + half] = uB - vB
        length <<= 1
    # No scaling for inverse as per original code

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n, k = map(int, input_data[0:2])
    keys = list(map(int, input_data[2:2 + int(input_data[2])]))
    v = [0] * 10
    for x in keys:
        v[x] = 1
    ans = [1]
    p = n // 2
    MOD = 998244353
    while True:
        if p % 2 != 0:
            ans = multiply_mod(ans, v, MOD)
        p //= 2
        if p == 0:
            break
        v = multiply_mod(v, v, MOD)
    res = 0
    for x in ans:
        res = (res + x * x) % MOD
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
